description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set. The chart contains ten slices, each representing a different data source. The largest slice, labeled “NQ”, is light blue and represents 31.3% of the data. “SNLI” is a grey slice representing 15.4%, followed by “FEVER” in orange at 16.1%. “VITAMINC” is a green slice at 13.0%, and “MULTIFC” is a yellow slice at 0.5%. “ANLI” is a dark orange slice representing 4.6%, while “FACTCC” is a light orange slice at 2.6%. “SCIFACT” is a dark green slice at 0.1%, “SCITAIL” is a brown slice at 1.2%, “PUBHEALTH” is a teal slice at 0.5%, and “ENTFA” is a red slice at 1.8%. The chart includes a legend labeling each slice, and percentage values are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
